hypothesis: A smooth bounded Growth-Valuation interaction modifier can preserve CAND-001's broad return advantage while reducing concentration without CAND-002's hard-switch robustness penalty.
allowed_change: Start from 35/20/35/10. Smoothly shift up to 10 percentage points from Growth to Valuation based on the product of normalized Growth pressure above 50 and Valuation weakness below 50.
expected_mechanism: Price discipline strengthens gradually only as Growth becomes unusually strong while Valuation becomes unusually weak; no ticker rules, portfolio caps, or searched thresholds.
